# Ajeem Suban

> Ajeem Suban (also written AJEEM.S) is an AI & Data Science Developer and the
> founder/creator of TAMIL-AI, a Tamil-first NLP/RAG platform. He builds AI/ML
> systems: retrieval-augmented generation pipelines, translation systems, and
> OCR tools for Indic languages.

## Identity

- Name: Ajeem Suban (alternate: AJEEM.S)
- Role: AI & Data Science Developer
- Flagship project: TAMIL-AI (founder/creator)
- Education: 3rd-year B.Tech, Artificial Intelligence & Data Science,
  Dhanalakshmi Srinivasan University (2024–2028)

## Projects

- [TAMIL-AI.ME](https://github.com/ajeem-suban/Project-TAMIL-AI.ME) — Tamil-first NLP/RAG platform.
  FastAPI + ChromaDB + IndicTrans2, with a KalVettu OCR sub-module for
  Chola-era stone inscriptions. Flagship project.
- [TITAN](https://github.com/ajeem-suban/Project-Assistant) — personal AI workspace / system control hub,
  React + TypeScript, powered by SECRAIN as its intelligence layer.
- [VCH-AGENT](https://github.com/ajeem-suban/VCH-AGENT) (Viral Content Hunter) — predictive AI system
  forecasting early viral-content signals on Reddit/YouTube.
- [SECRAIN](https://github.com/ajeem-suban/SECRAIN) — local-first AI "second brain": FastAPI + ChromaDB +
  Ollama.
- [AIRES](https://aires-demo-eight.vercel.app/) — AI emergency-dispatch/routing
  prototype ([source](https://github.com/ajeem-suban/AIRES-AI)).
- [Eye-Care-Tool](https://github.com/ajeem-suban/Eye-Care-Tool) — context-aware 20-20-20 desktop daemon
  (OpenCV/MediaPipe).
- [news-bot](https://github.com/ajeem-suban/news-bot) — automated Telegram news digest (RSS + Gemini +
  GitHub Actions).
- [CULLINAN AI](https://github.com/ajeem-suban/cullinan-ai) — personal AI identity & image generation
  system using facial embeddings (active development).
